run_pipeline_generate_image: run CogView3PlusPipeline to generate an image from a text prompt using classifier-free guidance
build_pipeline_with_custom_timesteps: build CogView3PlusPipeline with custom timesteps or sigmas for the diffusion scheduler
encode_prompt_text_embeddings: encode text prompts into T5 hidden state embeddings with optional negative prompts for classifier-free guidance
prepare_latents_diffusion_input: prepare random noise latents scaled by the scheduler's init_noise_sigma for the denoising loop
run_denoising_loop_inference: run the denoising loop to iteratively refine latents and decode final image via VAE
